{{Short description|American basketball player (born 2002)}} {{for|the American football player|Cam Jones}} {{Infobox basketball biography | name = Kam Jones | image = | caption = | number = | position = [[Point guard]] / [[shooting guard]] | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 5 | weight_lbs = 200 | league = | team = | birth_date = {{birth date and age|2002|02|25}} | birth_place = | high_school =[[Evangelical Christian School]]
([[Cordova, Tennessee]]) | college = [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]] (2021–2025) | highlights = * Consensus second-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2025 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2025]]) * First-team [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] (2025) * Second-team All-Big East (2023) * [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman team (2022) }} '''Kameron Jones''' (born February 25, 2002) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette Golden Eagles]]. ==Early life and high school== Jones grew up in [[Memphis, Tennessee]] and boxed in addition to playing basketball.{{cite news |title=Marquette Golden Eagles' Kam Jones likes basketball and boxing |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2023/11/20/marquette-golden-eagles-kam-jones-likes-basketball-and-boxing/71619918007/ |access-date=January 14, 2024 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |date=November 20, 2023}} He attended [[Evangelical Christian School]], where he was coached by Willie Jenkins. Despite not being the most athletic player, Jones sometimes played at center to enhance his skills around the rim.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/12/16/marquette-basketball-breakout-sophomore-kam-jones-having-success-2022-23-season/69729350007/|title=An artist in the paint: How Marquette's Kam Jones learned creative ways to score around the basket|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=December 16, 2022|access-date=January 14, 2024}} He averaged 14.3 points, 4.2 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game as a sophomore and was named to the All-District team.{{cite web |title=Standout Prep Guard Kameron Jones Joins Marquette |url=https://gomarquette.com/news/2020/11/11/mens-basketball-standout-prep-guard-kameron-jones-joins-marquette |website=[[Marquette Golden Eagles]] |access-date=January 15, 2024 |date=November 11, 2020}} As a junior, Jones averaged 19.1 points, 5.5 rebounds and 3.4 assists per game.{{cite news |last1=Branham |first1=Travis |title=2021 combo guard Kameron Jones commits to Marquette |url=https://247sports.com/Article/Kameron-Jones-commitment-Marquette-148685570/ |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=247 Sports |date=June 30, 2020}} Jones committed to play [[college basketball]] at [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]] over offers from [[South Alabama Jaguars men's basketball|South Alabama]] and [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]].{{cite news |last=Thompson|first=Khari|url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/high-school/2020/06/22/high-school-basketball-ecs-kameron-jones-having-air-force-dad/3191050001/|title=How having an Air Force sergeant for a dad shaped ECS basketball star Kameron Jones|date=June 22, 2020 |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=[[The Commercial Appeal]]}} ==College career== Jones averaged 7.4 points per game as a freshman, earning [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman Team honors.{{cite news |last1=Steele |first1=Ben |title=Aggressiveness is paying off with free throws for Marquette guard Kam Jones |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/12/05/marquette-basketball-guard-kam-jones-earning-more-free-throws/69701326007/ |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |date=December 5, 2022}} As a sophomore, Jones averaged 15.1 points, 3.6 rebounds, and 1.4 steals per game.{{cite web |last1=McCleary |first1=Michael |title=Analyzing the difficulty of Wisconsin men's basketball's nonconference schedule |url=https://badgerextra.com/sports/basketball/men/wisconsin-mens-basketball-nonconference-analysis/article_80d5b7d2-4099-11ee-8ddc-23166091769b.html |website=Badger Extra |access-date=January 14, 2024 |date=August 23, 2023}} He was named to the Second Team All-Big East.{{cite web |title=All-BIG EAST Teams Announced |url=https://www.bigeast.com/news/2023/3/5/mens-basketball-all-big-east-teams-announced.aspx |website=[[Big East Conference]] |access-date=January 15, 2024 |date=March 5, 2023}} In the NCAA Tournament, he scored 18 straight points in a 78–61 first round win against [[Vermont Catamounts men's basketball|Vermont]].{{cite news |last1=Stacy |first1=Mitch |title=March Madness: Jones, Marquette roll over Vermont 78–61 |url=https://apnews.com/article/march-madness-vermont-marquettencaa-tournament-f95c79547ea1ba0c37043e6a2ca01760 |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=[[Associated Press]] |date=March 17, 2023}} As a junior, Jones averaged 17.2 points, 2.4 assists, 2.9 rebounds and 1.1 steals per game. He helped Marquette reach the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament.{{cite web |last1=Gambill |first1=Mike |title=Kam Jones staying put at Marquette Basketball for 2024-25 season |url=https://bustingbrackets.com/posts/kam-jones-staying-put-at-marquette-basketball-for-2024-25-season-01hv9f1tb54f |website=Busting Brackets |access-date=January 4, 2025 |date=April 12, 2024}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://gomarquette.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/kam-jones/7095 Marquette Golden Eagles bio] {{2025 NCAA Men's Basketball Consensus All-Americans}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Jones, Kam}} [[Category:2002 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:All-American college men's basketball players]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Memphis, Tennessee]] [[Category:Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
